findings.title: Exact page-size multiples show a phantom page
findings.body: `floor(user_count / limit) + 1` counts an extra page whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the page size. For example, a group with 50 members displays `1/2`; the next action then requests offset 50 and shows an empty page. Compute the ceiling of the page count (while preserving the zero-member case) so pagination does not expose an unusable page.
